dialogues.value: Great, you're still around 305. Thought we lost you with the communications. The new pulse bullet you bought should come in handy at shooting down those stalctites.
Navigate the area carefully, theres something big down there and its messing with our comms.
This place is so cold. Better pay me well for this one.
What was that? You're cutting out again.
There's a vendor up ahead that can help you to find a lost vendor who can help you with the upcoming challenge, obviously you must pay him.
More spending! I better be getting that bonus.
Well you don't need to get it, it would just help you out.
Oh hey, it's me, your favourite bin man! You remember the deal from last time.
Got a great item for you, causes a devastating blow! But it will cost ya.
Lets say 250, c'mon not that bad right?.
Really? More money? You're real greedy.
